user.title: Solar of Things Cloud
user.description: Read-only cloud telemetry. Enter the device ID and a session token from your own Solar of Things app. Nothing is written back to the inverter.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the cloud session
reauth_confirm.description: The previous session can no longer be renewed. Paste a fresh access token and its matching refresh token from your app.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot retrieve fresh telemetry. Check the device ID, session and cloud connectivity.
